headings.h1: font-serif text-5xl sm:text-6xl+ tracking-tight leading-none text-stone-900
headings.h2: font-serif text-3xl sm:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-tight text-stone-900
headings.h3: font-serif text-2xl sm:text-3xl tracking-tight leading-snug text-stone-900
headings.h4: font-sans text-lg sm:text-xl font-medium tracking-wide text-stone-800

typography.eyebrow: font-mono text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-terracotta-700 font-semibold

textures: Subtle SVG noise overlay with 2-3% opacity for a true paper feel across the main body.
Never use full-screen gradients. Use solid colors or grainy texture.
borders: Thin borders (1px) using stone-200 or stone-300 to separate sections, creating an editorial grid structure.
Card borders should be subtle: border border-stone-200.
shadows: Minimal to none. Rely on borders and background color contrast for depth.
Hover states can have a subtle lift: shadow-[0_4px_20px_-4px_rgba(28,25,23,0.08)].
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-none or minimal rounded-sm (2px-4px) to maintain a classic editorial, non-SaaS look.

layouts.page_structure: Left-aligned asymmetric layout. High use of negative space (p-12, py-24). Avoid centered standard SaaS templates.

hero.structure: Single primary hero, left-aligned. Wide left column (8 cols) for text, narrow right column for negative space or abstract paper texture.
hero.content: Eyebrow: 'THE COMPASS PHILOSOPHY'. Headline: 'AI that develops thinking. Not replaces it.' Subtext: 'An experimental educational system designed to coach students through the messy, beautiful process of thought.'

philosophy.structure: A bold, high-contrast text section. Split into two clear sides (Bento/Grid).
philosophy.content:
Left Side (Muted): 'Most AI systems answer questions.
Most AI systems generate writing.
Most AI systems replace the struggle.' Right Side (Terracotta/Bold): 'Compass develops thinking.
Compass builds the thinking that makes writing possible.
Compass coaches the struggle.'
philosophy.styling: Background: stone-100 or a slightly darker paper hue. Huge serif text for the statements.

entry_points.structure: 3 asymmetric cards or staggered grid items. Not standard SaaS cards—think editorial sidebars or index cards.

cards.title: Experience Compass
cards.description: Experience our instructional philosophy and provide feedback while Compass is still in early development.
cards.style: Dominant card, terracotta background, stone-50 text.

cards.title: Student Writing Experience
cards.description: Explore how Compass coaches a student through a blank page.
cards.style: Secondary card, paper background, stone-200 border.

cards.title: Student Organizing Thought Experience
cards.description: See how Compass helps structure chaotic ideas into logical arguments.
cards.style: Secondary card, paper background, stone-200 border.

roadmap.styling: Use thin connecting lines (border-t border-stone-300). Monospace labels for the timeline steps.

explainer.structure: 4-step vertical list with large inset numbers.
steps: Understanding: Grasping the student's current cognitive state.
Recognition: Identifying the precise block or gap.
Developmental Invitation: Prompting the student to take the next step.
Teaching: Guiding the execution of the new thought.
explainer.styling: Border-b on each step. Large serif numerals (text-4xl text-stone-300) juxtaposed with dark text.

framer_motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up. initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
framer_motion.hover: Subtle border color change or background darkening. No heavy scaling.
framer_motion.scroll: Use whileInView for the philosophy and explainer sections to trigger staggered fades.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure terracotta text (#8C3A2A) on paper (#F9F8F6) passes WCAG AA for normal text. (It has ~5.5:1 ratio).
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for framer-motion setups.

paper_texture.description: Warm plain beige paper texture, can be used as a very subtle background layer or hero accent.

student_thinking.description: Student thoughtfully looking at a book. Excellent for the 'See Compass in Action' or Philosophy section.

media.icons: lucide-react. Use thin stroke widths (strokeWidth={1.5}). Key icon: Compass, BookOpen, PenTool, GitCommit.

component_instructions.buttons: Do NOT use generic pill buttons. Use sharp, rectangular editorial buttons. border border-stone-900 px-6 py-3 font-sans text-sm uppercase tracking-wider hover:bg-stone-900 hover:text-stone-50 transition-colors.
component_instructions.cards: Avoid standard drop-shadow cards. Use 'flat' cards with 1px border-stone-200 and a background color that slightly contrasts with the page (e.g., bg-white or bg-stone-100 on a stone-50 body).
component_instructions.navigation: Classic editorial top nav. Left aligned logo/wordmark in Serif. Right aligned clean links. Sticky with a backdrop-blur and thin bottom border.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
Never apply universal transition (transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

For this specific project: Maintain the warm paper-grain background, terracotta accent (#8C3A2A), serif display headings, and mono uppercase tracked eyebrows. DO NOT INVENT a generic purple/blue SaaS identity.
Provide design rules specifically for React JS (.js files), not TSX.
